transcript.statement: The safety of the autonomous driving system is paramount. My requirements SAF-01, SAF-02, and SAF-03 establish a robust safety framework that ensures hazard mitigation and fault tolerance. SAF-04 addresses passenger comfort, which is essential but must not compromise safety during critical maneuvers. SAF-05 and SAF-06 ensure that the system can operate safely under dynamic conditions. SAF-07 emphasizes the need for emergency protocols that can relax smoothness constraints while maintaining safety. I raise conflicts with EfficiencyAgent’s EFF-07, which prioritizes smoothness over safety during emergencies.

requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture ensuring collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical failures, ensuring safe stopping.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue timely warnings for human takeover.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation and allow for relaxation during emergencies.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints within 50 milliseconds.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time while ensuring energy efficiency.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption and access control to protect user data.
The system shall conduct regular security audits and integrate security checks during Minimal Risk Maneuvers.
The system shall ensure compliance with Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions for accountability and regulatory purposes.
